name: allowed-tools-missing-tool-name
description: #62: allowed_tools present but tool_name OMITTED — the forbid errors at evaluation and is SKIPPED, so both engines return Allow (same native semantics as read-only-missing-attribute). Production safety does not rest on Cedar here: policy.py always sets tool_name alongside allowed_tools, and _eval_tier re-raises on diagnostics.errors → fail-closed DENY. If a binding changes this natively, this fixture failing is the early warning.
